models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Registered customer accounts with email/password authentication, profile information, and account status.

Customers are the primary shoppers in the platform who browse products, manage carts, place orders, write reviews, and manage wishlists. Each customer has a unique email address for authentication and can maintain profile information including display name and phone number.

**Key Business Rules:**
- Email must be unique across all customer accounts (case-insensitive)
- Password is stored as secure hash, never in plaintext
- Account deletion is soft delete; orders and reviews are preserved with 'deleted user' attribution
- Banned customers cannot log in to the platform

**Relationships:**
- Has many {@link shopping_mall_addresses} for shipping destinations
- Has one {@link shopping_mall_carts} for shopping cart
- Has many {@link shopping_mall_wishlists} for saved products
- Has many {@link shopping_mall_orders} for purchase history
- Has many {@link shopping_mall_reviews} for product feedback
- Has many {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions} for authentication sessions
- Has many {@link shopping_mall_customer_password_resets} for password recovery

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's email address used for authentication. Must be unique across all customer accounts. Case-insensitive comparison for uniqueness validation.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plaintext. Uses one-way hashing algorithm for security.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Customer's display name shown in reviews and public interactions. Maximum 50 characters. Can be edited by customer at any time without approval.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Customer's phone number for contact purposes. Can be edited by customer at any time without approval.

plainFields.name: banned
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether customer account is banned by administrator. Banned customers cannot log in. Default is false.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer account was deleted (soft delete). Null if account is active. When deleted, orders and reviews are preserved with 'deleted user' attribution.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: Customer authentication session records tracking login events with connection metadata. Each session represents a single authenticated login instance with IP address, request URL, and referrer information captured for security auditing. Sessions have expiration timestamps and are append-only records that cannot be modified after creation. Used for session management, security monitoring, and audit trail maintenance.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Authenticated customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client that initiated the login session. Used for security auditing and anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL or endpoint that initiated the session. Captures the full URL including path and query parameters for session context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP Referrer header value from the login request. Identifies the source page or application that directed to the authentication flow.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created (login time). Used for session lifecycle management and audit trails.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Required for security to enforce session timeouts. Sessions are considered invalid after this timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for customer account recovery with expiration tracking.

This table stores secure password reset tokens that enable customers to recover access to their accounts when they forget their passwords. Each token has an expiration time and tracks whether it has been used, ensuring security and preventing token reuse.

The token field stores a cryptographically secure hash of the reset token, not the plaintext token itself. This ensures that even if the database is compromised, attackers cannot use the stored values to reset passwords.

Relationships:
- Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_customers} (many password resets per customer)
- Referenced during the password reset verification flow

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer requesting the password reset. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Hashed password reset token used for verification during the account recovery process. This is a cryptographically secure hash, not the plaintext token sent to the customer's email.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the password reset token. Tokens become invalid after this time for security purposes. Typically set to 1-24 hours from creation.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was successfully used to reset the password. Null if the token has not been used yet. Once set, the token is considered consumed and cannot be reused.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was created. Used for audit trails and to identify the most recent reset request for a customer.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Registered seller accounts with email/password authentication, shop profile information, approval workflow status, and account standing.

Sellers are authenticated actors who create and manage products, handle inventory, process shipments, and respond to cancellation/refund requests. They require administrator approval before they can sell on the platform.

**Authentication**: Sellers log in with email and password. Password changes are supported through the password reset flow.

**Approval Workflow**: New seller registrations start with approval_status='pending'. Administrators review and approve or reject applications. Rejected sellers can view the rejection reason and submit new registration requests.

**Account Standing**: Sellers can be suspended (temporary, products hidden but can process existing orders) or banned (cannot log in) by administrators. Suspended sellers cannot create new products but can fulfill existing orders.

**Account Deletion**: Sellers can delete their account only if they have no pending order items (paid or shipped status) and no pending cancellation/refund requests. Upon deletion, their products are removed from listings, but order history and snapshots are preserved for legal and dispute resolution purposes.

**Relationships**: Has many {@link shopping_mall_products}, has many {@link shopping_mall_seller_sessions}, has many {@link shopping_mall_seller_password_resets}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller's email address used for authentication. Must be unique across all seller accounts. Used for login identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for authentication. Stored using secure hashing algorithm (bcrypt/argon2). Never stored in plaintext.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Display name of the seller's shop. Visible to customers on product listings and order details. Required for shop profile.

plainFields.name: shop_description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the seller's shop. Optional field for providing additional shop information to customers.

plainFields.name: logo_image
plainFields.description: URL to the seller's shop logo image. Displayed on product listings and seller profile page. Optional field.

plainFields.name: approval_status
plainFields.description: Current approval status of the seller account. Values: 'pending' (awaiting admin review), 'approved' (can sell products), 'rejected' (cannot sell, can reapply). New registrations default to 'pending'.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by administrator when rejecting a seller registration. Only populated when approval_status is 'rejected'. Visible to the rejected seller for improvement guidance.

plainFields.name: suspended
plainFields.description: Whether the seller account is suspended by an administrator. Suspended sellers cannot create or edit products, but their existing products are hidden and they can still process existing orders. Defaults to false.

plainFields.name: banned
plainFields.description: Whether the seller account is banned by an administrator. Banned sellers cannot log in to the platform. Used for severe policy violations. Defaults to false.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created. Recorded automatically on registration.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated. Automatically updated on profile changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was soft-deleted. Null if account is active. Upon deletion, products are removed but order history and snapshots are preserved for legal purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for seller authentication tracking login sessions with connection context. Each session represents a single authentication event for a seller account, storing the connection metadata (IP, URLs) and temporal boundaries. Sessions support concurrent logins across multiple devices with a maximum duration of 24 hours. Sessions are automatically invalidated when the seller account is banned, suspended, or when password is changed, and can be manually invalidated on explicit logout.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique session identifier used as the 'sid' claim in JWT tokens for seller authentication sessions.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated seller's account. Belonged seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. This session is valid only for this specific seller account.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client at the time of session creation. Used for security auditing and session tracking to identify the source of authentication requests.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL (href) where the authentication was initiated. Captures the landing page or entry point for the seller's login session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value from the authentication request. Identifies the referring page that led to the login page for security tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created. This is the login time and is recorded when authentication succeeds. Used for session duration tracking and audit purposes.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expires. Maximum session duration is 24 hours from creation. Sessions must be invalidated after this time regardless of activity. NOT NULL by default for security enforcement.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for seller account recovery. Stores time-limited, unique tokens that allow sellers to securely reset their passwords. Tokens are created when a seller requests a password reset and expire after a defined period for security. Each token is single-use and invalidated after password change or expiration.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller account requesting the password reset. References {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. A seller can have multiple password reset tokens (e.g., if they request multiple resets before using one).

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique, cryptographically secure reset token used to authenticate password reset requests. Must be single-use and invalidated after password change or expiration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was created. Used for audit trail and token age validation.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token expires. Tokens past this time are invalid and must not be accepted. Enforces time-limited access for security.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrators
models.description: Administrator accounts with email/password authentication and grade-based privilege management. Supports two grades: regular administrator (seller approval, category management, user banning, product oversight, forced order operations) and super administrator (all regular privileges plus administrator request review, promotion/demotion authority). Administrators are created through approval of AdministratorRequest submissions by super administrators. Account separation is maintained from customer/seller accounts when users hold multiple roles.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator email address used for authentication. Must be unique across all administrator accounts. Used as login identifier.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for administrator authentication. Must meet platform password complexity requirements (minimum length, uppercase, lowercase, numeric digit).

plainFields.name: grade
plainFields.description: Administrator privilege level. Valid values: 'regular' (standard administrative functions), 'super' (elevated privileges including administrator request approval, promotion/demotion authority). Super administrators cannot demote themselves. At least one super administrator must exist in the system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created. Set automatically on account creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last modified. Updated automatically on profile changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was soft-deleted. Null for active accounts. Preserves account record for audit trail when removed.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_sessions
models.description: Administrator login session records tracking authentication sessions with connection metadata. Each session represents a single administrator login with IP address, requested URL path, referrer information, and expiration timestamp. Sessions are created upon successful authentication and used for JWT token validation and session management. Sessions support audit trails for administrator access patterns and can be invalidated on logout or security events. Related to {@link shopping_mall_administrators} via the administrator relationship.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: The administrator who owns this session. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from which the administrator logged in.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL path that the administrator accessed during authentication. Used for session tracking and redirect purposes.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP Referrer header indicating the previous page from which the administrator navigated to the login page. Optional as some browsers may not send this header.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created upon successful authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Used for JWT token validation and session timeout enforcement. Always set to enforce security limits.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for administrator account recovery with expiration tracking. Each token is uniquely identified by a code and links to a specific administrator account. Tokens expire after a defined period for security, and usage is tracked through the used_at timestamp. This entity supports the administrator password reset workflow and is managed through administrator-related operations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator account requesting password reset. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token code used for verification during the reset process. Must be cryptographically secure and single-use.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the reset token. Tokens cannot be used after this time for security reasons.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was created.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was used, if applicable. Null if the token has not been used yet or expired unused.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:
Product categories with optional parent-child hierarchy for organizing products.

Categories provide the primary organizational structure for the product catalog. Each category can have an optional parent category, enabling one level of nesting (subcategory). Categories are created and managed exclusively by administrators and are browsable by all customers.

When a category is deleted, products belonging to that category become uncategorized. Categories are non-transactional metadata and do not require snapshot tracking.

Key relationships:
- Self-referential parent-child relationship for subcategories
- Referenced by {@link shopping_mall_products} for product categorization

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category reference for subcategory relationship. When set, this category is a subcategory of the referenced parent. Only one level of nesting is allowed (parent must be a top-level category). Null for top-level categories.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique category name displayed to customers and used for product categorization. Required field that must be unique across all categories.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the category, its purpose, and the types of products it contains. May be null for categories without detailed descriptions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was created by an administrator.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was soft-deleted. Null for active categories. Soft delete preserves referential integrity while hiding from customer view.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Product catalog entries created by sellers, containing name, description, base price, and category assignment. Each product belongs to exactly one seller who owns and manages it. Products must be assigned to exactly one category (top-level or subcategory). Products must have at least one variant to be purchasable. Products are soft-deletable with snapshots preserved for dispute resolution. Sellers can edit their products, with each edit creating an immutable snapshot. Product deletion is blocked if any variant has pending order items (paid/shipped) or pending cancellation/refund requests.

Key Relationships:
- Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_sellers} (owner)
- Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_categories} (category assignment)
- Has many {@link shopping_mall_product_images} (product images)
- Has many {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} (product variants/SKUs)
- Has many {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshots} (edit history)
- Referenced by {@link shopping_mall_wishlist_items} (customer wishlists)
- Referenced by {@link shopping_mall_reviews} (customer reviews)

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owner seller of this product. References {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Products are created and managed by sellers. When seller is suspended, products are hidden from search and category listings.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category assignment for this product. References {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}. Each product must be assigned to exactly one category (top-level or subcategory). When assigned to subcategory, product appears in both subcategory and parent category listings.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name displayed in search results and product detail pages. Required field for all products. Used in product search functionality with full-text search support.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description explaining features, specifications, and usage. Required field for all products. Displayed on product detail page.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price for the product in the platform's currency. Required field. Must be a positive value. Variants can override this price with their own pricing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was created. Set automatically on product creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last updated. Updated automatically on every edit. Used to determine when snapshots should be created.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was soft-deleted. Null if product is active. Deleted products are removed from search and category listings but snapshots are preserved for dispute resolution.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description: Product images serving as visual representations of products in the catalog. Each product can have multiple images with controlled display order, where the first image (lowest display_order value) serves as the main thumbnail shown in search results and category listings. Images are managed by sellers through product operations and are included in product snapshots when products are edited for historical preservation. Supports JPEG, PNG, and WebP formats with secure URL protocols.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product this image belongs to. Images cascade delete when the parent product is deleted. References {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL pointing to the product image file. Must use secure protocols (HTTPS) and point to an accessible location. Supports JPEG, PNG, and WebP image formats.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Numerical display order determining the image's position in the product gallery. Lower values appear first. The image with the lowest display_order is used as the main thumbnail in product listings and search results. Must be unique within the same product.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was uploaded. Used as secondary sorting criterion when multiple images have the same display order value, and for audit trail purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Specific SKU configurations for products with unique SKU codes, option values (color, size, etc.), and optional price overrides. Each variant represents a distinct purchasable combination of product options and has its stock quantity managed through inventory records.

Sellers create and manage variants for their products, defining option combinations like 'Red / Large' or 'Blue / Small'. Customers select specific variants when adding items to their cart. The variant's price can override the product's base price, and stock availability is calculated by summing all associated inventory records.

When a variant is deleted, it is soft-deleted and no longer appears in product listings. Variants with pending orders or requests cannot be deleted. Every edit to a variant creates a snapshot for audit trail purposes.

Relationships:
- Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_products} (required)
- Has many {@link shopping_mall_inventory_records} for stock tracking
- Referenced by {@link shopping_mall_cart_items} and {@link shopping_mall_order_items}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product this variant belongs to. Each product can have multiple variants representing different option combinations. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the variant across the entire platform. Must be 3-50 characters, alphanumeric and hyphens only, cannot start or end with hyphen, and no consecutive hyphens. This code is used for inventory tracking and order processing.

plainFields.name: option_values
plainFields.description: JSON object containing the variant's option attributes as key-value pairs (e.g., {"color": "Red", "size": "Large"}). Each variant must have at least one option attribute, with a maximum of 5 attributes. Attribute names are 1-30 characters, values are 1-50 characters. The combination of option values must be unique within each product.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Optional price that overrides the product's base price for this specific variant. If not set, the product's base price is used. Must be between 0.01 and 999,999.99 with up to 2 decimal places when specified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was soft-deleted. Deleted variants are not displayed in product listings but data is preserved for historical records and audit trails.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshots
models.description:
Historical snapshots of product state created automatically on every product edit, preserving the complete product information including name, description, base price, and images at a specific point in time.

These snapshots serve critical business purposes:
- Audit Trail: Provides complete history of product modifications for accountability
- Dispute Resolution: Serves as legal evidence in customer-seller disputes regarding product details at time of purchase
- Version Control: Allows tracking of product evolution over time
- Data Integrity: Ensures historical accuracy even when products are deleted or heavily modified

Each snapshot captures the product state exactly as it existed when the edit was made. Snapshots are immutable and cannot be modified or deleted, preserving the integrity of historical records.

Related entities:
- Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_products} (the product being snapshotted)
- Has many {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshot_skuses} (variant states at time of snapshot)

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product whose state is preserved in this snapshot. References {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name at the time of snapshot creation. Preserved exactly as it appeared when the product was edited.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description at the time of snapshot creation. Preserves the full text content for historical reference and dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product at the time of snapshot creation. Stored as decimal to preserve exact pricing for transaction records and dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: images
plainFields.description: JSON array of product image URLs at the time of snapshot creation. Preserves complete image state including display order. First image in array represents the main/thumbnail image. Stored as JSON to maintain exact image configuration as it existed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created, marking the exact moment of product edit. Used for chronological ordering of product history.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshot_skuses
models.description:
Historical snapshot of product variant state embedded within product snapshots. Captures SKU code, option values, price override, and stock quantity at the exact moment of product edit creation. Part of the complete product state preservation system that ensures transaction integrity for dispute resolution and historical tracking.

Each snapshot SKU record is immutable and linked to its parent product snapshot. Preserves variant information exactly as it existed, even if the original variant is later modified or deleted. Supports complete historical reconstruction of any product's variant configuration at any point in time.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent product snapshot. Each variant snapshot belongs to exactly one product snapshot, preserving the complete product state at a point in time.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: SKU code of the product variant at the moment of snapshot creation. Preserved exactly as it existed when the product was edited, serving as a unique identifier for the variant configuration at that time.

plainFields.name: option_values
plainFields.description: JSON representation of variant option values (e.g., {"color":"Red","size":"Large"}). Preserved at the moment of snapshot creation for historical accuracy. Stored as JSON string to capture complete option configuration.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Price override of the variant at snapshot time. Nullable if the variant uses the product's base price instead of a custom override. Preserved for accurate price history tracking in dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Stock quantity of the variant at the exact moment of snapshot creation. Preserved for inventory history tracking and to show availability context at the time of product edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant snapshot was created. Matches the parent product snapshot's creation time for consistency.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_records
models.description:
Stock movement ledger for product variants using an additive approach.

Each record documents a quantity change (positive for restocks, negative for orders/adjustments) with a reason and timestamp. Current stock for any variant is calculated by summing all inventory records for that variant. Records are immutable and provide a complete audit trail for dispute resolution and transparency.

Supports manual restocking, manual adjustments, and automatic stock updates triggered by order placement, cancellations, and refunds. Each record tracks its source through optional foreign key references to orders, cancellation requests, refund requests, or sellers (for manual adjustments).

Relationships:
- Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} (the variant being adjusted)
- Optionally references {@link shopping_mall_orders} (for order-triggered deductions)
- Optionally references {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_requests} (for cancellation-triggered restorations)
- Optionally references {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests} (for refund-triggered restorations)
- Optionally references {@link shopping_mall_sellers} (for manual adjustments)

foreignFields.name: variant_id
foreignFields.description: The product variant whose stock is being adjusted. References {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order that triggered this inventory deduction. Only populated for automatic records created during order placement. Null for manual adjustments, cancellations, and refunds.

foreignFields.name: cancellation_request_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the cancellation request that triggered this stock restoration. Only populated for automatic records created when a cancellation is approved. Null for other record types.

foreignFields.name: refund_request_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the refund request that triggered this stock restoration. Only populated for automatic records created when a refund is approved. Null for other record types.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who performed this manual inventory adjustment. Only populated for manual restocking or adjustment records. Null for automatic records (order, cancellation, refund triggered).

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: The quantity change for this inventory movement. Positive values indicate stock additions (restocking, refund restoration). Negative values indicate stock deductions (order placement, adjustments, losses). Zero values allowed for correction entries.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: The reason for this inventory change. For manual entries, contains seller-provided explanation (e.g., 'Initial stock', 'Damaged goods adjustment'). For automatic entries, contains system-generated description (e.g., 'Order placed', 'Cancellation approved', 'Refund processed').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was created. Used for chronological history tracking and audit trail purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description: Customer shopping cart sessions with one-to-one relationship to customers for managing product selections before checkout. Tracks creation and modification timestamps for session persistence across logins. Cart is cleared after successful order placement but not deleted, remaining available for future shopping sessions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this cart. Enforces one-to-one relationship where each customer has exactly one cart. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was created. Used for session tracking and persistence across customer logins.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was last modified. Updated when cart items are added, modified, or removed. Used for session management and cleanup policies.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Individual items in shopping carts referencing specific product variants with quantity.

Each cart item represents a customer's selection of a specific product variant (SKU) added to their cart for purchase. The quantity field tracks how many units of the variant the customer intends to buy. When the same variant is added again, quantities are merged into a single cart item rather than creating duplicates.

The unavailable flag marks items whose variants have been deleted by sellers or are out of stock. Unavailable items remain in the cart to preserve product information for customer reference but cannot be checked out until removed or restocked.

Cart items are automatically removed when orders are successfully placed, converting each item into an order item with its preserved product and pricing information.

**Relationships:**
- Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_carts} (many items per cart)
- References {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} for the selected SKU
- Indirectly references shopping_mall_products through the variant
- Indirectly references shopping_mall_sellers for seller association

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: The cart this item belongs to. Each cart can have multiple items, each referencing a different product variant. {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The specific product variant (SKU) selected for purchase. Customers must select a variant when adding to cart, not just the product. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of the variant selected for purchase. Must be a positive integer (minimum 1). When the same variant is added to cart again, quantities are merged by adding to the existing quantity rather than creating a duplicate item.

plainFields.name: unavailable
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this item's variant is unavailable (deleted by seller or out of stock). Unavailable items remain in the cart to preserve product information but cannot be checked out. When stock becomes available again, this flag is cleared.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the item was first added to the cart. Used for sorting cart items and tracking customer shopping behavior.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the item was last modified, such as when quantities are merged when the same variant is added to cart again. Tracks all changes to the cart item's state.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description: Main wishlist entity providing one-to-one relationship with customers for managing their saved product collections. Each customer has exactly one wishlist that can contain multiple products for future consideration. Serves as a monitoring list rather than a purchase intent, separate from the active shopping cart workflow.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who owns this wishlist. Each customer has exactly one wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was last updated (e.g., when items were added or removed).

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description: Individual product entries stored in customer wishlists for future consideration. Each entry references a product at the product level (not variant-specific), with creation timestamp for sorting by most recently added. Enforces uniqueness constraint to prevent duplicate products per wishlist. Automatically removed when referenced product is deleted by seller.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: The wishlist this item belongs to. Each customer has exactly one wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product saved in the wishlist. References products at the product level only, not variant-specific. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was added to the wishlist. Used for sorting wishlist items by most recently added first.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Customer purchase transactions created at checkout with unique order number, total price, derived status, and immutable shipping address. Orders aggregate order items from potentially multiple sellers, and status is derived from individual item statuses. Order history is preserved even after customer account deletion for seller records and legal purposes.

Each order captures the complete shipping address as individual immutable fields at checkout time, preserving the destination details exactly as they were provided regardless of subsequent changes to the customer's address book.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed the order. May be null if customer account is deleted, as orders are preserved for seller records and legal purposes. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique order identifier generated at order creation. Used for customer reference and order lookup.

plainFields.name: total_price
plainFields.description: Total price of all order items at the time of purchase. Sum of (item price × quantity) for all items.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Order status derived from order items: 'paid' (all items paid), 'shipped' (any shipped), 'delivered' (all delivered), 'cancelled' (all cancelled), 'refunded' (all refunded), or 'partially_completed' (mixed states). Cached for efficient querying.

plainFields.name: shipping_recipient_name
plainFields.description: Recipient name for the shipping address as captured at checkout. Immutable after order creation.

plainFields.name: shipping_phone_number
plainFields.description: Phone number for delivery contact as captured at checkout. Immutable after order creation.

plainFields.name: shipping_street_address
plainFields.description: Street address for delivery as captured at checkout. Immutable after order creation.

plainFields.name: shipping_city
plainFields.description: City for delivery as captured at checkout. Immutable after order creation.

plainFields.name: shipping_state_province
plainFields.description: State or province for delivery as captured at checkout. Immutable after order creation.

plainFields.name: shipping_postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal code for delivery as captured at checkout. Immutable after order creation.

plainFields.name: shipping_country
plainFields.description: Country for delivery as captured at checkout. Immutable after order creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when order was created after successful payment.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when order was last updated, typically when derived status changes due to order item status changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion, used when customer deletes account. Orders are preserved with null customer reference.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Individual purchased product variants within customer orders, tracking quantity, price at purchase time, and independent fulfillment status.

Each order item represents a specific product variant purchased by a customer, with its own lifecycle through paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, or refunded states. Order items enable independent processing per item, allowing customers to cancel individual items before shipment or request refunds for delivered items.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_orders} for order context
- References {@link shopping_mall_products} for product identity
- References {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} for specific SKU configuration
- References {@link shopping_mall_sellers} for seller attribution and fulfillment responsibility
- Optionally references {@link shopping_mall_shipments} when shipped (null until shipped)

Price is captured at purchase time to preserve transaction value regardless of subsequent product price changes. Status progresses independently per item, enabling mixed order states where some items ship while others are cancelled.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: The order this item belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product purchased. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The specific variant (SKU) purchased with its option configuration. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller responsible for fulfilling this item. Enables seller-specific order views and multi-seller order distribution. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipment_id
foreignFields.description: The shipment this item is included in. Null until the seller creates a shipment. Items from the same seller can be bundled into one shipment or shipped separately. {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units purchased for this product variant. If the same variant is purchased multiple times, quantities are consolidated into a single order item.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Unit price at time of purchase. Captured from the product variant's price (or product base price if no variant override) to preserve transaction value for historical accuracy and dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current fulfillment status of this item. Values: 'paid' (awaiting shipment), 'shipped' (in transit), 'delivered' (received by customer), 'cancelled' (cancelled before shipment with refund), 'refunded' (refunded after delivery). Each item tracks status independently within an order.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was created during order placement.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was last modified, such as status changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft delete. Set when order data is archived or removed from active view while preserving transaction history.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable purchase-time records that preserve the complete product, variant, and seller state at the moment of purchase for transaction integrity and dispute resolution.

When a customer successfully places an order, this snapshot captures the product name, product description, exact price paid, seller shop name, and seller logo image exactly as they existed at purchase time. This creates a permanent historical record that cannot be modified or deleted, ensuring customers and sellers have authoritative evidence of transaction terms for dispute resolution.

The snapshot remains unchanged even if the original product is modified, variant is deleted, or seller changes their shop profile. Links to {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id} for complete purchase context. Variant options are stored in normalized child table {@link shopping_mall_order_item_snapshot_variant_options} for proper 1NF compliance.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: The order item this snapshot preserves. Each order item has exactly one snapshot capturing purchase-time state. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}

plainFields.name: product_name
plainFields.description: Product name exactly as displayed to the customer at purchase time. Preserved character-for-character without modification.

plainFields.name: product_description
plainFields.description: Complete product description in full text format as shown during purchase. Preserves all formatting and content from the original product description.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Exact price the customer paid for this item at purchase. Uses variant override price if defined, otherwise product base price. Preserved unchanged regardless of subsequent price changes.

plainFields.name: seller_shop_name
plainFields.description: Seller shop name as it existed at the time of purchase. Preserved independently from seller profile changes.

plainFields.name: seller_logo_image
plainFields.description: URL of seller logo image as it appeared at purchase time. Preserved for historical reference even if seller updates their logo.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order item snapshot was created, marking the exact moment of purchase completion.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipments
models.description:
Shipment packages created by sellers for order fulfillment.

Represents a physical package shipped by a seller containing one or more order items from the same seller. When a seller ships items, they create a shipment with carrier name and tracking number. All items in the same shipment share the same tracking information.

Key behaviors:
- Sellers create shipments when shipping order items
- Sellers enter carrier name and tracking number
- Items can be bundled into a single shipment or shipped individually
- Customers view tracking information per shipment
- Delivery is confirmed by customer or automatically after 14 days
- When delivery is confirmed, all items in the shipment change to 'delivered' status

The shipment groups order items from the same seller for the same order. Order items reference the shipment they belong to via {@link shopping_mall_order_items.shipment_id}.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who created this shipment. References {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: The order containing the items in this shipment. Enables efficient querying of shipments for customer order views. References {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Name of the shipping carrier (e.g., FedEx, UPS, DHL). Entered by the seller when creating the shipment.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Tracking number provided by the carrier. Used by customers to track shipment status on the carrier's website.

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was created and the items were marked as shipped. Set automatically when the seller creates the shipment.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when delivery was confirmed. Set either by customer confirmation or automatically 14 days after shipping if not confirmed by customer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Set when the shipment record is marked as deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_requests
models.description: Customer requests to cancel individual order items before shipment. Each request includes a reason for cancellation, tracks status through pending/approved/rejected states, and records when the seller responds. Only one active cancellation request can exist per order item. When approved, the order item status changes to cancelled and stock is restored. Linked to {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots} for audit trail preservation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: The order item being requested for cancellation. Must have 'paid' status (not yet shipped). One active cancellation request per order item. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who responds to the cancellation request. Null until seller approves or rejects. Must match the seller of the order item. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer's explanation for requesting cancellation. Required text field explaining why the order item should be cancelled.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the cancellation request. 'pending' - awaiting seller response, 'approved' - seller accepted cancellation, 'rejected' - seller declined cancellation. Transitions: pending → approved or pending → rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created by the customer.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was last updated. Tracks status transitions and seller response.

plainFields.name: responded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller responded to the request. Null until seller approves or rejects.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshots of cancellation request state created when a seller responds to a cancellation request by approving or rejecting it. Captures the customer's original reason text, the seller's decision status, and the exact timestamp of response for permanent audit trail and dispute resolution.

This table serves as authoritative evidence for resolving disputes between customers and sellers regarding cancellation handling. Each snapshot represents a distinct point in the cancellation request timeline and cannot be modified or deleted after creation. Multiple snapshots may exist for a single cancellation request if the seller provides multiple responses over time.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_request_id
foreignFields.description: The cancellation request that this snapshot captures at the moment of seller response. {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_requests.id}

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: The original cancellation reason text provided by the customer when they submitted the cancellation request. Preserved exactly as entered without modification to maintain historical accuracy for dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: The status assigned by the seller's response. Valid values are 'approved' (seller authorized the cancellation) or 'rejected' (seller denied the cancellation). Snapshots are only created upon seller response, so this value is never 'pending'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when the seller responded to the cancellation request and this snapshot was created. Serves as the official record of when the cancellation decision was made.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_requests
models.description: Customer requests to refund delivered order items within the 7-day eligibility window. Each request is associated with exactly one order item and can only be created for items with 'delivered' status. The seller who owns the product can approve or reject the request, triggering stock restoration and order status recalculation upon approval. All state changes are preserved in shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots for audit trail and dispute resolution.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: The order item being requested for refund. Must have 'delivered' status and be within 7 days of delivery. Each order item can have at most one active (pending) refund request. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer's explanation for requesting the refund. Required field with minimum 10 characters and maximum 1000 characters. Preserved exactly as submitted in snapshots for dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the refund request. Values: 'pending' (awaiting seller response), 'approved' (seller approved, refund processed), 'rejected' (seller declined). Initial status is always 'pending'. Status transitions are one-way: pending → approved or pending → rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund request was submitted by the customer. Used to validate the 7-day eligibility window from the order item's delivery date.

plainFields.name: responded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller responded to the request (approved or rejected). Null until seller responds. Preserved in snapshots for audit trail.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshots of refund request state changes, capturing reason and status when seller responds for audit trail and dispute resolution.

Each snapshot preserves the complete state of a refund request at a specific point in time, typically when the seller approves or rejects the request. These snapshots ensure transaction integrity and provide evidence for dispute resolution between customers and sellers.

Snapshots are append-only records that cannot be modified or deleted, maintaining a permanent audit trail of all refund request state transitions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the refund request being snapshotted. {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests.id}

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: The reason text for the refund request at the time of this snapshot. Preserves the customer's explanation for requesting a refund.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: The status of the refund request at the time of this snapshot. Valid values: 'pending', 'approved', or 'rejected'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created, typically when the seller responded to the refund request.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_item_snapshot_variant_options
models.description: Normalized child table for storing variant option key-value pairs at purchase time, decomposing variant configuration into atomic values for 1NF compliance. Each row captures one option (e.g., color=Red, size=Large) preserving the exact variant state when the customer placed their order. Supports dispute resolution by providing clear evidence of what the customer purchased.

foreignFields.name: order_item_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order item snapshot that contains this variant option. {@link shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots.id}

plainFields.name: option_key
plainFields.description: Name of the variant option, such as "color", "size", or "material". Preserved exactly as defined at purchase time for dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: option_value
plainFields.description: Value of the variant option, such as "Red", "Large", or "Cotton". Captures the exact customer selection at purchase time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant option record was created. Matches the order item snapshot creation time for consistency.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description:
Customer reviews for delivered products with rating (1-5 stars) and optional text content.

Reviews are linked to customer, product, and order for purchase verification and to enforce the one-review-per-product-per-order constraint. Reviews can only be written after the order item status becomes 'delivered'. Customers can edit their reviews (creating snapshots via {@link shopping_mall_review_snapshots}) or soft-delete them. Soft-deleted reviews are preserved and displayed as 'deleted user' for historical transparency.

Reviews are displayed on product detail pages sorted by newest first, and contribute to the product's average rating calculation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who wrote this review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product being reviewed. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: The order through which this product was purchased. Used for purchase verification and enforcing one review per product per order. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Star rating from 1 to 5. Required field representing the customer's overall satisfaction with the product.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Optional text content of the review. Can contain detailed feedback about the product.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was soft-deleted. Soft-deleted reviews are preserved and displayed as 'deleted user' for historical transparency.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshots of review state preserved when reviews are edited, supporting audit trails, dispute resolution, and edit history tracking.

Each snapshot captures the complete state of a review (rating and content) at the moment before an edit is applied. Snapshots are created automatically when customers modify their reviews and cannot be modified or deleted by any actor, including administrators.

The snapshot ensures accountability and transparency in the review system by preserving evidence of all changes, preventing review manipulation, and providing historical proof for dispute resolution. Even when the parent review is deleted, all associated snapshots are retained indefinitely for compliance and audit purposes.

Relationships:
- Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_reviews} (1:N - one review can have multiple snapshots)
- Maintains indirect relationship to customer, product, and order through the parent review

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: Parent review's {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}. Links snapshot to the review whose state was captured before an edit.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Star rating value (1-5) as it existed before the edit. Preserved to show the customer's original assessment before modification.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Text content of the review as it existed before the edit. May be null if the review had no text content at the time of the snapshot. Preserved exactly without modification for dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created, marking the exact moment when the review was edited. Used to establish chronological order of edit history.

models.name: shopping_mall_addresses
models.description:
Customer shipping addresses with complete destination information for order delivery.

Each address contains recipient name, phone number, street address, city, state/province, postal code, and country. Customers can have multiple addresses with one designated as default for checkout convenience.

Addresses are copied to orders at checkout rather than referenced, preserving the address state at time of purchase through the order's shipping_address field. This ensures historical accuracy even if customers modify or delete addresses later.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to {@link shopping_mall_customers} (many addresses per customer)

Soft deletion via deleted_at allows addresses to be removed from customer's active list while preserving any historical references in past orders.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Owner customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. Each customer can have multiple shipping addresses.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Name of the person who will receive the package at this address.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Contact phone number for delivery coordination at this address.

plainFields.name: street_address
plainFields.description: Street address including house/building number and street name.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City or locality name for the shipping address.

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: State, province, or region name for the shipping address.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal or ZIP code for the shipping address.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country name for the shipping address.

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: Whether this address is the customer's default shipping address. Only one address per customer can be default. Used for automatic selection at checkout.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the address was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the address was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the address was soft-deleted. Null for active addresses. Soft deletion preserves address history for past orders.
